title: Scene text detection in Indian languages
summary: B.Tech research on finding text in Indian street photos: auditing the TextBPN++ detector, fixing a preprocessing mismatch, and fine-tuning faster detectors on the Bharat Scene Text Dataset.

credit.text: IndicPhotoOCR, its paper and the Bharat Scene Text Dataset belong to the Bhashini / VL2G lab at IIT Jodhpur. Only the work listed here is mine.
credit.citation: De, Penamakuri, Yadav, Rathore, Shah, Sharma, Agarwal, Kumar, Mishra. Bharat Scene Text: A Novel Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Indian Language Scene Text Understanding. IJDAR, 2026.

problem: The Bharat Scene Text Dataset's 1,319 test images are high resolution. Once resized for a detector, small words shrink to a few pixels and get missed, and very large words break the detector too.

contributions.title: Audit
contributions.text: Reproduced and audited the TextBPN++ detector on all 1,319 test images. Built a polygon-IoU evaluation harness with per-image error logs and text-size stratification, which exposed a recall collapse on small text (under 20 px: recall 0.35) and on very large text (over 320 px).

contributions.title: Preprocessing fix
contributions.text: Traced a train/inference preprocessing mismatch: inference skipped the mean/std normalization the model was trained with. Fixing it raised detection recall from 0.621 to 0.670 and F1 from 0.656 to 0.675, without retraining.

contributions.title: Small text
contributions.text: Scale-aware 1.5× upscaling lifted small-text F1 from 0.47 to 0.59. Tiled inference was tested and rejected: it added 67 false positives for 4 true positives.

contributions.title: Fine-tuning
contributions.text: Fine-tuned YOLO11, docTR FAST and DPText-DETR on 4.7K training images, with polygon-to-box conversion, EXIF and coordinate correction, and a leak-free 90/10 split (test set held out). The fine-tuned YOLO raised end-to-end OCR word recall from 50.7% to 54.3% and F1 from 51.0% to 53.8%. It is now the toolkit fork's default detector (5.5 MB, release yolo11n-bstd-v1.0).

contributions.title: Benchmark
contributions.text: Benchmarked 10 text detectors (EAST, CRAFT, DBNet++ and others) and IoU-based polygon-fusion ensembles to map the precision–recall trade-off. A 5-model ensemble reached recall 56.7% but precision only 40.3%.
